release_notes:
Easier access to the FAQ from inside the app.

The online FAQ & Troubleshooting page was only reachable from the website -- there was no link to it anywhere in the app. This release adds two:

1. A new 'FAQ & Troubleshooting (web)...' item at the top of the Help menu opens the FAQ in your default browser.

2. The Help > About dialog now shows the FAQ address and offers to open it for you (click Yes).

Both point at the same published page (https://ayodoood.github.io/Chairside-Ready-Alert/FAQ.html), which also got a refresh this week: a new 'Installation Instructions' section explaining what a LAN is and how to set a second Wi-Fi router to Bridge/Access-Point mode so wired and wireless workstations can find each other, a note about the occasional stick-figure animation, and corrected Microsoft Store pricing (one-time purchase, not the old monthly subscription). No other behavior changes.
